configs.model_routing:
# config/model_routing.yaml
routing:
  scout:
    primary:
      provider: "anthropic"
      model:    "claude-3-5-haiku-20241022"
      temperature: 0.2
      max_tokens:  4096
      timeout:     30
    fallback:
      provider: "google"
      model:    "gemini-2.0-flash"
      timeout:   30

  evaluator:
    primary:
      provider:    "anthropic"
      model:       "claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219"
      temperature: 0.0          # حتمية كاملة لتقييم الأهلية
      max_tokens:  8192
      timeout:     40
    fallback:
      provider: "google"
      model:    "gemini-2.0-flash"

  drafter:
    primary:
      provider:    "anthropic"
      model:       "claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219"
      temperature: 0.3          # إبداعية محسوبة ومضبوطة للصياغة
      max_tokens:  16384        # مساحة واسعة للعروض الطويلة
      timeout:     90
    fallback:
      provider: "openai"
      model:    "gpt-4o"

  manager:
    primary:
      provider:         "anthropic"
      model:            "claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219"
      response_format:  "json_object"  # إلزام النموذج بإخراج JSON منضبط
      timeout:          60

  default:
    primary:
      provider: "google"
      model:    "gemini-2.0-flash"
      timeout:  30
configs.sources_watchlist:
# config/sources_watchlist.yaml — influencer system (Instagram only)
# Approved source is Instagram only at this stage (founder decision, 25 Oct 2026).
# The database's 15-group source registry is a separate register; it does not widen this allowlist.
blocked_ip_ranges:
  - "10.0.0.0/8"         # RFC 1918 — private networks
  - "172.16.0.0/12"      # RFC 1918
  - "192.168.0.0/16"     # RFC 1918
  - "127.0.0.0/8"        # Loopback
  - "169.254.169.254/32" # AWS/GCP IMDS
  - "fd00::/8"           # IPv6 ULA

approved_sources:
  instagram:
    name:   "Instagram"
    domain: "instagram.com"
    paths:  ["/"]

constraints:
  max_timeout:         10
  max_response_size:   5242880
  methods:             [GET, HEAD]
